description: Run the three local repository checks on a source folder: repo-secrets (secret-shaped strings in the working tree and git history), gitignore-env-coverage (every .env variant ignored) and env-example-parity (.env.example lists every variable the code reads, with no real values). Runs entirely on this machine; nothing is sent anywhere. Findings show a six-character prefix of any secret, never the value. Folder trust: the first call for a path returns a confirmation request instead of results. Show the user the absolute path and call again with trust: true once they confirm it is their project. Trust lasts for this server process.

path.description: Folder to scan. Defaults to the server's working directory. Relative paths resolve against it. Must be inside the working directory or a folder listed in SECUREALY_SCAN_ROOTS.

trust.description: Set true on the second call to confirm the user trusts this folder being read, including its git history.

name: scan_repo
title: Scan a repository
